import numpy as np, model, torch
np.set_printoptions(precision=2,suppress=True)
net=model.load(); neg=model.negatives(); uid=list(neg['uid'])
mem=[2,5,22,34,67,99,101,112,129,134,149,176,180]
torch.manual_seed(1)
T=[]
for u in mem:
    i=uid.index(u); c=float(neg['c'][i]); xi0=neg['xi'][i]; a0=neg['a'][i]
    xi=torch.randn(1024,2); a=np.asarray(model.decode(net,xi,torch.full((1024,),c)))
    inb=model.in_basin(i,a)
    nang=np.arctan2(xi[:,1],xi[:,0]).numpy()
    # circular mean of bad noise angles
    m=np.angle(np.exp(1j*nang[inb]).mean())
    d=np.angle(np.exp(1j*(np.arctan2(xi0[1],xi0[0])-m)))
    aang=np.arctan2(a[:,1],a[:,0]); ca=np.angle(np.exp(1j*aang[inb]).mean())
    # neighbor modes: samples whose action angle is ca±45 +-15
    sgn=1 if d>0 else -1
    # check which direction noise angle maps: compare correlation
    tgt_ang=ca+sgn*np.pi/4
    # does increasing noise angle increase action angle? find sign
    good=~inb
    cand=good & (np.abs(np.angle(np.exp(1j*(aang-tgt_ang))))<np.radians(12))
    # nearest sample to a0 rotated
    rot=np.array([np.cos(sgn*np.pi/4),np.sin(sgn*np.pi/4)]); R=np.array([[rot[0],-rot[1]],[rot[1],rot[0]]])
    ar=R@a0
    P=a[cand]; j=np.argmin(np.linalg.norm(P-ar,axis=1)) if len(P) else None
    # also verify noise-angle neighbors of xi0 map where
    nn=np.argsort(np.abs(np.angle(np.exp(1j*(nang-(np.arctan2(xi0[1],xi0[0])+sgn*0.6))))))[:20]
    side=np.angle(np.exp(1j*(aang[nn]-ca))).mean()
    print(u, round(c,3), 'bad share',inb.mean().round(3),'d',round(float(d),2),'sgn',sgn,'noise-side action offset deg',np.degrees(side).round(1),'target',P[j] if j is not None else None, 'a0',a0)
    T.append(P[j])
np.save('T_split.npy',np.array(T,dtype=np.float32))
